summary: Frees the two pointer members of a dual-pointer object. Reads and releases the pointer at byte offset 0x18 first (if non-null), then the pointer at byte offset 0x10 (if non-null), returning the result of the last FreeWrapper_7bcf call. Used as a node/tree cleanup helper by RecursiveTreeTraversalFree and sub_567CC0.

operations.description: Read the pointer at byte offset 0x18 (this + 24) into the result register.
If the pointer at byte offset 0x18 is non-null, free it with FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Read the pointer at byte offset 0x10 (this + 16) into v3.
If the pointer at byte offset 0x10 is non-null, free it with FreeWrapper_7bcf and return its result.
Otherwise return the earlier free result (previous FreeWrapper_7bcf result, or 0 when offset 0x18 was null).

unresolved: Owner object and the meaning of the two pointer members (child/sub-object pairs) are not evidenced by this packet.
Whether the two freed pointers share allocation ownership or one is borrowed is caller-specific and unresolved.
